entries.title: Hebrews 8:1
segments: The pith of all that we have been saying is this; we do have such a High Priest; and he has taken his seat on the right hand of the throne of Majesty in the heavens,

entries.title: Hebrews 8:2
segments: a minister of the sanctuary and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, not man.

entries.title: Hebrews 8:3
segments: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices; whence it follows that this High Priest also must have some offering to make.

entries.title: Hebrews 8:4
segments: Now were he on earth, he would not even be a priest, since there are here those who present the gifts according to the Law--

entries.title: Hebrews 8:5
segments: those priests who serve a mere outline and shadow of the heavenly reality, just as Moses was divinely instructed when he was about to build the Tabernacle: "See", he says, "that you make everything on the pattern showed you on the mountain."

entries.title: Hebrews 8:6
segments: But Jesus has obtained a better ministry, by so much as he is also Mediator of a better covenant, which has been enacted upon better promises.

entries.title: Hebrews 8:7
segments: For if the first covenant had been faultless, there would have been no need for a second.

entries.title: Hebrews 8:8
segments: But finding fault with them, He says: "There are days coming," says the Lord, "When I will establish with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah a new covenant;

entries.title: Hebrews 8:9
segments: Not according tot he covenant which I made with their forefathers, On the day when I took them by the hand to lead them forth out of the land of Egypt; For they did not continue in my covenant, And therefore I disregarded them," says the Lord.

entries.title: Hebrews 8:10
segments: "For this is the covenant which I will covenant with the house of Israel, After these days," says the Lord; "I will put my laws into their minds, And upon their hearts will I write them; And I will be their God, And they shall be my people;

entries.title: Hebrews 8:11
segments: And they shall not teach every man his fellow citizen, And every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord; For all shall know me, From the least to the greatest of them.

entries.title: Hebrews 8:12
segments: For I will have mercy upon their wrong-doings, And their sins I will remember no more."

entries.title: Hebrews 8:13
segments: By calling the covenant "new," He has made the first one obsolete; and whatever is becoming obsolete and aged, is near to vanishing.
